title: A review of the impact of formative assessment on student achievement in mathematics
exact_quote_or_excerpt: The results show positive relations between student achievement in mathematics and the ways of doing formative assessment.
finding: Formative assessment is positively related to maths achievement, which supports the value of diagnosis but not that centres would pay for a tool.
limitations: Academic study, abstract-level; not evidence of purchasing by Singapore tuition centres. Gap: Does not address primary-level diagnosis tools or purchasing by tuition centres.

title: The effect of a formative assessment practice on student achievement in mathematics
exact_quote_or_excerpt: The 14 teachers who participated in the PDP taught a total of 291 students (the intervention group). The students belonging to this group were 148 females and 143 males. The remaining 15 teachers (6 females, 9 males) that taught year-7 mathematics that school year taught a total of 275 students (the control group).
finding: The study evaluated mathematics achievement outcomes for 291 intervention students and 275 control students across participating secondary schools.
limitations: The study measures general secondary mathematics achievement rather than specifically diagnosing primary mathematics learning gaps.
